chunks: If only the unbelievers could apprehend the moment when they would neither be able to ward off the fire from their faces and their backs, nor help reach them!

key_terms.الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا: the disbelievers / those who rejected faith

ai.seo_question: What happens to disbelievers when they face the Hellfire and can no longer ward it off?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Anbiya underscores the total helplessness of the disbelievers when the barriers of divine mercy are lifted, illustrating the finality of their fate. It highlights that neither their physical orientation nor any intercessor can avert the punishment, reinforcing the concept of divine justice where each soul bears its own burden.
